facts.fact: Adwave marks every tool that spends as destructive, so the host app asks the user first.
facts.quote: every tool that spends is marked destructive

facts.fact: In Adwave, launching and resuming set the day's budget aside from the user's wallet.
facts.quote: launching and resuming set the day’s budget aside from your wallet

facts.fact: In Adwave, the user is charged the next morning only for what ran, never more than the amount set aside for the day.
facts.quote: never more than the amount set aside

facts.fact: In Adwave, a day during which the campaign stays paused is never charged.
facts.quote: A day the campaign stays paused is never charged.

facts.fact: In Adwave, wallet top-ups happen on Stripe's hosted page, never in the assistant chat.
facts.quote: top-ups happen on Stripe’s hosted page, never in chat

facts.fact: In Adwave, connected assistants are listed and can be disconnected under Settings, For developers, Connected apps, and disconnecting does not stop running ads.
facts.quote: Disconnecting removes the assistant’s access and doesn’t stop your ads.

facts.fact: Adwave runs campaigns only in the US and Canada.
facts.quote: Adwave runs campaigns in the US and Canada only

facts.fact: According to Jon Loomer, Meta's connector inherits the signed-in Facebook user's account access.
